name: roemer-light-speed
description: Ole Rømer's 1676 measurement of the speed of light, reconstructed from the eclipses of Io: light-time delay shown against the true configuration, and a log in which a student times eclipses and works the speed out for themselves. Czech and English.
author: Richard Lipka

scripts.//scripts: The trailing `--` matters for dev: without it npm appends extra arguments bare, so `npm run dev -- --port 5184` reaches vite as npm config flags and the port is silently ignored.
